public.title: Compact Spaces
public.description: Given a string, remove leading and trailing ASCII spaces and replace each internal run of ASCII spaces with one space. Preserve all other characters exactly, including tabs and newlines. The string has at most 1000 characters.
hints: Only the ordinary ASCII space character is removed or combined.
public.attribution: Original exercise authored for Bekor, 2026. No third-party exercise material used.

explanation: Remove spaces at both ends, then replace every remaining nonempty run of spaces with a single space. Do not use a general whitespace operation because tabs and newlines must survive.
